slideContent:
We are inviting you on a spiritual journey to explore your faith and encounter God in a new way. And, we hope that once you truly get to know God, you will love Him as much, or even more than we do.

Some of what you may learn may seem familiar. Some daily meditations may surprise you. While others might challenge what you’ve believed about God for a long time.

That’s okay. That’s the point.

Here's what to expect each day.

Each daily meditation will last roughly 15 - 25 minutes.

It may include:

  • A short teaching

  • A scripture to sit with

  • Sometimes a video or song

  • A reflection or activity

  1. Read slowly.

  2. Notice what stands out.

  3. Talk to God about it.

You practiced reading Scripture with attentiveness and invited the Holy Spirit to guide you. The Bible is the living word of God that offers meaning to our lives. It speaks to us! It explains the truth of how the world fell into chaos, because of sin, and God’s rescue plan to save us through His son Jesus.

The scriptures share with us God’s message of love and mercy and give us hope.

We have provided a Lumen Fidei chat to share your thoughts, ask questions, or relay any difficulties as you journey through each week. This provides an easy way to ask for prayers too.

Introduce yourself and share one thing you hope to gain from the next 30 days.

After each module, you will have space to write down your reflections, thoughts, emotions, or questions.

There are no right or wrong answers. This is simply a place to pause, process, and be honest about what is coming up.

This course is a prerequisite to prayer sessions.

At the end, you’ll be invited to a personal prayer session with the ministry. Completing this 30 day journey is necessary to strengthen your relationship with Jesus and help determine whether you need deliverance.

Many people discover that unforgiveness becomes a heavy burden that quietly affects their peace, relationships, and spiritual life and HINDERS them from being delivered altogether.

What your prayer session actually is.

A prayer session with our ministry runs about 90 minutes. Two or three ministers are in the room, under the direction of a priest. You sit, you talk about what has come up in this course, and then prayer begins.

The prayer starts general and narrows. You will renounce specific things out loud, in your own voice. We will pray specific prayers of healing and, where appropriate, deliverance. It is not dramatic. It is often quiet. It is almost always powerful.

Whatever you have seen in movies, put it aside. The real work is different.

subtitle: You did it!
completionMessage: "Be not afraid. Open wide the doors for Christ." — St. John Paul II
slideContent:
How to prepare for your session.

Five things to do before you come:

  • Go to confession within the week before your session. If you have not been yet, go now. This is the single most important preparation.

  • Fast the day of the session, if your health allows — bread and water, or skip a meal. Ask your mentor if unsure.

  • Rest the night before. Do not come exhausted or rushed.

  • Pray the Our Father, Hail Mary, and Glory Be the morning of. Just those three, slowly.

  • Come with what you have named across these 30 days — the footholds, the forgivenesses, the yes. We will work through them together.

subtitle: You did it!
completionMessage: "Be not afraid. Open wide the doors for Christ." — St. John Paul II
slideContent:
After the session.

The session is not the finish line. It is the door.

The first weeks after are the most important. Keep praying daily. Keep going to Sunday Mass. Go back to confession within a month. Stay close to the sacraments.

Your mentor will walk with you through the first month. Use them.
